purpose: Seal, before the entry, a cone of falsifiable statements with priors and the frozen plan for every candidate of the frozen detectors, the plan also applied to five matched twins drawn from the same scan; grade the statements and score the plan against the twins when the future arrives. Prospective only. No orders, no change to the paper policy, no variant of a retired entry, no holdout.
owner_decisions_respected: handoff/decisions/2026-10-17_retire_G2_RET30_crypto_entry.md: no further exit, sizing or filter variants on the crypto entry; descriptive logging allowed

handoff/decisions/2026-10-22_close_US_plus30_line_and_take_the_blueprint_next_step.md: no further buy-side variant of the US entry, including a delayed entry and a regime filter; descriptive logging allowed

CRYPTO.fixed_entry: Binance spot quote at sealing time (candidate and twins)
CRYPTO.sealing_cutoff: 02:00 UTC of the day after the signal day

BASE5.what: the frozen plan: the validated harness plan, prospectively, beside twins

PATH20.what: the 20-session price path of the candidate and its twins; no plan

plan_rules.costs: idxsig/profiles.py per market; US and crypto tiers at the price as traded
plan_rules.roll: an exit on a session where a sale is impossible rolls to the next session where it is
plan_rules.data_end: a name whose bars end before its exit, with the market's bars >= 10 sessions past the target, is sold at its last traded close
plan_rules.levels: compared on the reference chain (cumulative close/previous)
plan_rules.redenomination: CRYPTO: a close/previous ratio > 10 or < 0.1 inside the window makes the candidate UNRESOLVABLE and drops a twin
plan_rules.twins: the plan is applied identically to each twin (its own signal close and fill conditions)

cone.statement: a close in s+1..s+5 is >= 1.30 x the signal close
cone.prior_source: E30 precision: research/E1/validation/result.json sha256 388e8111..., research/E2/US/validation/result.json d7f05fcc..., research/E2/CRYPTO/validation/result.json 1b8c3bc4...

share of scored trades with net_return <= -0.10 in results/runs/20261009T050040Z_MOONSHOT_E1_D1_v1.1 (n 251), 20261008T115656Z_MOONSHOT_E2_US_D1_v1 (n 536), 20261008T005732Z_MOONSHOT_E2_CRYPTO_D1_v1 (n 264)
share of scored trades with net_return > 0 in the same runs

cone.statement: the BASE5 net return exceeds the median BASE5 net return of the twins that traded
a close in s+1..s+20 is >= 1.30 x the signal close
cone.prior_source: the register's running base rate in the market; 0.5 while fewer than 20 resolved

cone.statement: a close in s+1..s+20 is >= 2.00 x the signal close
cone.prior_source: the register's running base rate in the market; 0.5 while fewer than 20 resolved

twins.pool: fresh and eligible on the signal session, not flagged by the selected detector, not a candidate, close > 0 (IDX >= 50)

tag.hot_day: flags of the selected detector in this scan > median of the previous 20 scans' counts; null below 10 earlier scans; metadata only, nothing reported conditional on it

resolution.units: paper-score-v3 rules (split records after the signal, SEC-corroborated for US; never price ratios)
resolution.data: live bars pulled after each session only; no panel holdout segment is read

decision_rule.question: does the frozen plan's net return exceed its twins' prospectively?
decision_rule.unit: signal session (sets of one session averaged first)
decision_rule.test: one-sided t on per-session mean paired differences, df = sessions - 1
decision_rule.family: one plan per market (Holm over one member is the raw p)
decision_rule.eligible: p < 0.05 and t >= 3.0 and mean net return after costs > 0
decision_rule.confirmed: eligible at a look and at the next look
decision_rule.promotion: never automatic: evidence for the owner; any policy change is the owner's and a new PAPER-POLICY version

forbidden: new plans, statements, priors or thresholds in v1
any variant of a retired entry
